current_evidence: The council's 'About planning' page says 'Our current Local Validation List was adopted on 24/08/2026' and its 'View the Local Validation List' link points to this exact PDF; every page of the PDF carries 'Adopted 24/08/2026' (web search still surfaces the superseded 2024 list).

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none) - national requirements only', but the list has a dedicated Householder section with local requirements. Mandatory items: CIL Additional Information Form 1, Floor Plans, Photos, Fire Safety Strategy Part A, and a BNG exemption declaration (flats and maisonettes do not qualify for the exemption). Conditional items: Block Plan (extension beyond walls or new outbuilding); Roof Plans (new roof element); Sections (change in floor-to-ceiling height or significant level difference); Streetscenes (additional new storey, but not loft conversions or dormers); Window Sections (new windows on listed or locally listed buildings, or replacement windows in a conservation area); Archaeological Desk-based Assessment (within 50m of an Ancient Monument with new footings); Basement Impact Assessment (new or extended subterranean levels); Contaminated Land Assessment; Crossover Agreement (new or amended vehicular crossover); Ecological Assessment (loft or roof alterations within a SINC or Green Corridor); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2 or 3 with new footings, or new subterranean levels); Heritage Statement (conservation area, listed or locally listed building); Tree survey, AIA and AMS (trees within 7.5m of footings; trees 7.5-15m away need a marked plan and labelled photos).
issues.evidence: Part 2 Application Type Guide - 'Householder (extensions to single family dwellinghouses; not flats or maisonettes)'

issues.detail: Other application types are all shown as '(none)' even though Part 2 and Part 4 of the list set out specific local requirements for each. Advertisement: Photos (M); Heritage Statement (C); Lighting Assessment (C, new external spot or floodlights). Lawful Development Certificate (proposed): CIL Form 1 (M), Floor Plans (M), Photos (M), Roof Plans (C), Block Plan (C); existing-use LDCs need form, fee, location plan and evidence. Listed Building Consent: Heritage Statement (M), Fire Safety Strategy Part A (M), CIL Form 1 (M), Floor Plans and Photos (M), Demolition Method Statement (C, demolishing a listed or locally listed building), Archaeological DBA (C, within 50m of an Ancient Monument), Tree survey (C, within 7.5m). Minor Material Amendment (s73): Schedule of proposed changes (M), BNG (M where the original permission was submitted on or after 12 Feb 2024), CIL Form (M if the footprint changes). Non-Material Amendment: Schedule of proposed changes (M). Details reserved by condition: documents as appropriate to the condition. Works to protected trees: Photos (M), Site Plan with labelled trees (M), Schedule of Works (M), Reason for Works (M for TPO), Arboricultural Report (M if the reason is tree condition), Subsidence/Structural Damage Report (M if the reason is alleged damage). Outline: all documents for the relevant Major/Minor category apart from those for reserved matters.
issues.evidence: Part 2 sections 'Advertisement', 'Lawful Development Certificate'; Part 4 'Listed Building Consent', 'Minor Material Amendment (S73)', 'Non-Material Amendment', 'Outline Permission', 'Works to Protected Trees'

issues.detail: Every Full planning row is flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The source has no 'Full' category. It splits full applications into Major (10+ dwellings, 999sqm+ floorspace or site over 1ha), Minor (1-9 dwellings, up to 999sqm, or works to flats and maisonettes) and Change of Use, and a requirement is often Mandatory for Major but Conditional or absent for Minor. Examples: Ecological Assessment is M for Major but only C for Minor (within or within 100m of a SINC, or loft/roof alterations); Energy Statement is M for Major but C for Minor (new dwellings); SUDS Strategy is M for Major but C for Minor (new footprint of 5sqm or more, or commercial-to-residential); Landscaping Scheme is M for Major but C for Minor (if BNG applies); Statement of Community Engagement, Construction Management Plan and Parking Management Plan are Major only. None of this distinction is captured.
issues.evidence: Part 2 'Major (10+ dwellings, 999sqm+ floorspace, or site over 1ha)' and 'Minor (1-9 dwellings, up to 999sqm floorspace, or works to flats and maisonettes)'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the Major, Minor and Change of Use sections that Grokbot did not capture: Air Quality Assessment and Air Quality Neutral Assessment (Major, M); BREEAM Pre-Assessment / Interim Design Stage Certificate (Major, M except residential-only schemes); Construction Logistics Plan (Major, M); Daylight and Sunlight Assessment (Major, M); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (Major, M); Drainage Assessment Form (Major, M); Planning Statement (Major, M); Skills and Employment Strategy (Major, M); Transport Assessment (Major, M); Travel Plan (Major, M); Waste Management, Storage and Collection Strategy (Major M; C for new dwellings in Minor and Change of Use); Demolition Method Statement (C, demolishing a building over two storeys or a listed or locally listed building); Contaminated Land Assessment (C, site on contaminated land); Cycle Store and Refuse Store plans/details (C, new or amended external store); Fire Safety Strategy Part A (M for Minor, Change of Use, Householder and LBC) as distinct from Fire Statement Part B (buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with two or more dwellings or educational use); GLA Environmental Policy Requirements, i.e. Circular Economy Statement, Whole Life-Cycle Carbon and Energy spreadsheets (C, GLA-referable size/height thresholds); Telecommunication Report (C, masts, base stations, cabinets); Crossover Agreement (C); Roof Plans and Window Sections (C); Schedule of proposed changes (C, NMA/MMA).
issues.evidence: Part 2 'Major' supporting documents list; 'Minor' and 'Change of Use' sections

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts come from neighbouring text and misstate when the requirement applies. Flood Risk Assessment: 'should be prepared for all developments', but the source says Flood Zone 2/3 with new footings, new subterranean levels, or sites of 1ha+. Design and Access Statement: the excerpt is demolition and construction-management text, but the trigger is any new dwelling or more than 100sqm of new floor area. Retail Impact Assessment: the excerpt is drawing-standards text, but the trigger is more than 2,499sqm of commercial floorspace outside a town centre. Basement Impact Assessment: 'Policies Map Basement Impact Assessment' (no trigger), but the trigger is new or extended subterranean levels. Archaeological DBA: 'Requirement Tips Archaeological Desk-based Assessment' (no trigger), but the trigger is ground disturbance in an Area of Archaeological Priority or new footings within 50m of an Ancient Monument. Tree survey: quotes BS5837 only and misses the 7.5m/15m distance triggers. Ecological Assessment: 'all planning applications must have consideration' wrongly implies it is always required. Fire Statement: a cut-off fragment ('Statement' or a Fire Safety Strategy A Fire Safety Strategy should indicate;'). Environmental Statement: 'traffic and EIA development.' Drainage/SuDS and Statement of Community Involvement share an excerpt mixed with the Skills and Employment form.
issues.evidence: Part 2 'Major'/'Minor' condition columns, e.g. FRA 'Flood Zones 2 or 3 with new footings; new subterranean levels; or sites of 1 hectare or more'

issues.detail: Several requirement rows are matched to text that has nothing to do with them. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes an arboricultural method statement sentence; in the source the schedule items are 'Schedule of proposed changes' for NMA/MMA and 'Schedule of Works' for protected-tree applications. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' quotes a demolition method statement checklist. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' quotes a section-drawing note about land levels, whereas the real item is the Daylight and Sunlight Assessment (Major, M). 'Photographs' gives the trigger 'format (including photographs).', but Photos are Mandatory for every application type. 'Parking provision' quotes '(the submitted parking survey) All submitted documents should be in PDF format'. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' quotes Circular Economy and Heritage Statement text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values vs Part 2/Part 3 entries in the source

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab items taken from the About planning web page are process text, not validation requirements: householder guidance booklets, the redaction-request process, 'validation typically takes three to five working days', and 'Copies of the Agenda will be available online at least 5 working days before the committee date'. Several drawing-standard items also have page-footer contact details pasted in ('London Borough of Sutton, Civic Offices, St Nicholas Way, Sutton, SM1 1EA developmentmanagement@sutton.gov.uk 14 Adopted 24/08/2026'), and some have reference-link titles joined on (e.g. 'Mayor's Supplementary Planning Guidance ... Institute of Air Quality Management All submitted documents should be in PDF format'). The CIL row's trigger also includes fee text ('Applications will not be validated without the appropriate application fee').
issues.evidence: tab_items sourced from sutton.gov.uk/w/about-planning; PDF page footer text

issues.detail: The same rule is repeated in tab_items: 'All plans must be submitted as separate single page PDF files' appears 3 times, 'All submitted documents should be in PDF format (including photographs)' 4 times, and the 'site must be edged in red ... north point' location-plan rule 3 times. 'Affordable Housing Statement' and 'Viability Assessment' are two rows with an identical excerpt for what the source treats as one combined item (Financial Viability Assessment and Affordable Housing Statement, C: affordable housing below 35%).
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Drawing / document standards' and 'Submission rules'; Major list 'Financial Viability Assessment and Affordable Housing Statement (C)'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (adopted 24/08/2026), though its date of 2026-08-01 comes from the URL. The content is poorly extracted: it misses the list's per-application-type structure (Householder, Minor, Major, Change of Use, LBC, Advertisement, LDC, s73/NMA, Trees all shown as '(none)'), omits more than 20 local requirements, and has many garbled or wrong triggers and boilerplate items.

withdrawn_issues.detail: List date 2026-08-01 was taken from the upload-month folder in the URL ('Date basis: url path'). The document and the planning page both give an adoption date of 24 August 2026.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Planning page: 'Our current Local Validation List was adopted on 24/08/2026'; PDF page footer: 'Adopted 24/08/2026'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The upload-folder basis is weak, but at month precision the value is right: adoption on 24/08/2026 gives 2026-08-01. Only the Date_basis needs changing.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.
